## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (typecheck, tests, build, bundle-size budgets)
- [ ] Browser tests pass, or I explained why not (`pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e`)
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader behaviour checked for any UI change
- [ ] Docs and README updated (`pnpm run docs` regenerates the generated parts)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), per the Developer Certificate of Origin
